# Home

> Enhance your cyber security operations with a comprehensive range of tools and resources for both offensive and defensive strategies.

- [Home](https://infosec.house/readme.md): Home
- [About](https://infosec.house/about.md): Bug reports for broken/incorrect links are best started as an Issue.
- [AI](https://infosec.house/ai.md): Break the machines that think. Tools for attacking and defending AI systems.
- [API](https://infosec.house/api.md): Poke every endpoint. Tools for pentesting APIs.
- [Assets Management](https://infosec.house/assets-management.md): Keep track of your inventory. You can't protect what you don't see.
- [Blogs & Zines](https://infosec.house/blogs.md): Read up before you break in. Blogs and zines from offensive security researchers.
- [Bug Bounty](https://infosec.house/bug-bounty.md): Hack for cash. Test your skills and get paid for finding vulnerabilities.
- [C2](https://infosec.house/c2.md): Command your implants. C2 tools and frameworks.
- [Changelog](https://infosec.house/changelog.md): Infosec House changelog. See what latest changes have been made!
- [Cheat Sheets](https://infosec.house/cheat-sheets.md): Quick-reference cheat sheets for offensive and defensive security work.
- [Cloud & Containers](https://infosec.house/cloud-containers.md): Storm the cloud. Tools for hacking cloud platforms and containers.
- [Collaboration](https://infosec.house/collab.md): Hack together. Tools for red team collaboration.
- [Cracking](https://infosec.house/cracking.md): Everything you need to crack all the hashes.
- [Cryptography](https://infosec.house/cryptography.md): How great is your cryptography?
- [CTF](https://infosec.house/ctf.md): Flex your skills. Offensive security capture-the-flag events.
- [Data Exfiltration](https://infosec.house/data-exfiltration.md): Exfiltrate the data, and test your DLP.
- [Default Passwords](https://infosec.house/default-passwords.md): Still using admin/admin? 1,000+ default passwords to check first.
- [E-Mail](https://infosec.house/e-mail.md): Phish, spoof, and pop inboxes. E-mail pentesting tools and resources.
- [Editors & Viewers](https://infosec.house/editor-viewer.md): Editors and viewers for digging into files of every format.
- [Education](https://infosec.house/education.md): Level up. Training and courses to master your craft.
- [Emulation](https://infosec.house/emulation.md): Emulate the adversary.

- [Evasion](https://infosec.house/evasion.md): Evade getting caught.
- [Exploits](https://infosec.house/exploits.md): Gather all your exploits needed to pop that box.
- [Firewalls](https://infosec.house/firewalls.md): Attack the castle doors.
- [Forensics](https://infosec.house/forensics.md): Uncover the dirty little secrets of a recovered HDD, Image, malware, and more.
- [Hardware](https://infosec.house/hardware.md): Gear up. The hardware every pentester keeps in their bag.
- [Honeypots](https://infosec.house/honeypot.md): Deploy honeypots to catch attackers in the act.
- [IDS/IPS](https://infosec.house/ids-ips.md): Detect and block intrusions before they do damage.

- [Malware](https://infosec.house/malware.md): All the malware you could wish for, ready to reverse engineer.
- [Mobile](https://infosec.house/mobile.md): Root it, jailbreak it, break it. Tools for attacking and defending mobile applications.
- [Music](https://infosec.house/music.md): Kick back, relax, and enjoy some entertainment.
- [Network](https://infosec.house/network.md): Sniff the network. Modify the packets.
- [Operating Systems](https://infosec.house/operating-systems.md): Operating systems for whatever task at hand.
- [Operation Security](https://infosec.house/opsec.md): Seek out technologies and methods of remaining anonymous in this day and age of mass surveillance.
- [OSINT](https://infosec.house/osint.md): Open-Source Intel. Get all the information needed for your target.
- [Privilege Escalation](https://infosec.house/privilege-escalation.md): Go from limited access to full control. Escalate your privileges on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- [Reconnaissance](https://infosec.house/recon.md): Understand your target. Perform in-depth research and discover new attack surfaces.
- [Reverse Engineering](https://infosec.house/re.md): Reverse engineering tools that both offensive and defensive operations can utilize.
- [Shells](https://infosec.house/shells.md): From pre-built webshells to fully custom ones.
- [Social Engineering](https://infosec.house/social-engineering.md): Manipulation techniques that exploit human error to gain private information, access, or valuables.

- [Threat Intel](https://infosec.house/threat-intel.md): Discover where the threats begin.
